worldcombat.skill.twineedle.summary: Raise two needles and fire them one after the other: the first opens the wound and the second drives into that same wound, so it carries poison more easily. Cross mode sends them in from both sides for a bigger second-hit bonus, but each needle is lighter and they are spaced further apart.
Power per needle %1$s (physical), range %2$s, flight speed %3$s, hit radius %4$s; one cast settles twice.
Gap between needles %1$s; each needle rolls poison at %2$s, and once the first lands the second gains +%3$s; poison lasts %4$s.
In the crossing variant, the needles are %1$s blocks apart. Wind-up: %3$s. Recovery: %4$s. Cooldown: %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.twineedle.cross.on: Cross needles: the second gains a x1.6 wound bonus and the two close in from both sides, but each needle is x0.9 and the gap grows by 2.
worldcombat.skill.twineedle.cross.off: Straight needles: both fly along one line with a shorter gap and x1.1 power each, but the second gets no flanking bonus.
worldcombat.skill.twineedle.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.twineedle.growth.0: From level %1$s the power per needle rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.twineedle.growth.1: From level %1$s the power per needle is %2$s and the second-hit bonus rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.twineedle.use.1: Use the second needle to land the poison
worldcombat.skill.twineedle.use.2: Keep a single target bleeding out
worldcombat.skill.twineedle.preference.c: On: the two needles close in from both sides and the second gains a x1.6 wound bonus, at the cost of x0.9 power per needle and +2 gap. Off (straight needles): both fly along one line with a shorter gap and x1.1 power each, but the second gets no flanking bonus.
worldcombat.skill.twineedle.preference.a: Beyond this distance it will not fire needles and closes in first; a larger value starts the exchange sooner.
When on, low-health targets rank higher so the reliable two hits finish them; when off, all targets rank the same.
When on, the companion may leave its post to fire its needles; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
